text: Boa noite, desculpe if this is a silly thing to send. My neta is 6, she has a sore throat since yesterday and tonight the temperature is 39.1, I think that is quite high? She is still drinking, água and some juice, no problem swallowing the drinks. And she is wide awake, sitting on the sofa watching her cartoons and talking to me sem parar, very lively. Her parents are away and I don't want to call for nothing. Is it ok to give her something and watch her, or should I take her somewhere?
